Settled by RUNNING, in an rsync copy, with mutations that reddened. (a) Mutual exclusion: 16 concurrent acquirers under -race, maxInside=1, wins=4/busy=12/other=0; deleting the !locked refusal gives maxInside=4 and the test fails. (b) Lock file mode is 0600 (gofrs/flock@v0.13.0 default perm, asserted on the real file). (c) RunLockHeld's three properties each verified with a discriminating mutation: no footprint when .tp/locks/ already exists (dropping the os.Stat guard reddens it - the naive version of this probe did NOT discriminate because OpenFile failed on the missing dir), a released marker reads not-held (returning true on file existence reddens), and a LIVE CROSS-PROCESS holder reads held (re-exec helper; my first attempt false-FAILed by syncing on a byte read that caught the test banner). Unlock is paired in both functions and the defer is set only after TryLock succeeded. MkdirAll 0o755 matches WithFileLock:59. RunBase uses filepath.Base so no traversal reaches the lock path. Two ignored errors are deliberate and stated in the comments: _ = fl.Unlock() at 81 and 124. Noted, not filed: every TryLock failure reads as not-held, so an unopenable lock file would let --status report a dead driver as live - documented at 64-67, and nothing in tp changes that file's mode after creating it 0600.
